Class Epilogue

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.epilogue.Epilogue

    • configure

      public static void configure(Consumer<EpilogueConfiguration> configurator)
      Applies a configuration function to the current configuration. The full set of options can be seen in EpilogueConfiguration. 
      Epilogue.configure(config -> {
  config.root = "Custom Telemetry Root";
  // ... among other options
});
      Parameters:
      configurator - the configuration function to apply
      See Also:
      • the full set of configurable options

    • update

      public static <R extends RobotBase> boolean update(R robot)
      Updates telemetry for the specified robot instance. Call this in a periodic method like IterativeRobotBase.robotPeriodic(). 
      import module wpilib;

@Logged
public class Robot extends TimedRobot {
  @Override
  public void robotPeriodic() {
    Epilogue.update(this);
  }
}
      Type Parameters:
      R - the robot type
      Parameters:
      robot - the robot instance to update
      Returns:
      true if telemetry was updated, false otherwise

    • bind

      public static <R extends TimedRobot> boolean bind(R robot)
      Binds periodic telemetry updates to the specified timed robot. Updates will execute at the frequency specified in getConfig(), with a phase offset of EpilogueConfiguration.loggingPeriodOffset to avoid collisions with the main robot task.

      This method is offered as a convenience for setting up telemetry in the robot constructor; it is not required to use Epilogue. Calling update(RobotBase) in IterativeRobotBase.robotPeriodic() would also work and would provide better timing control without phase offsets. 

      import module wpilib;

@Logged
public class Robot extends TimedRobot {
  public Robot() {
     Epilogue.bind(this);
  }
}
      Type Parameters:
      R - the timed robot type
      Parameters:
      robot - the timed robot instance to bind
      Returns:
      true if a matching bindable logger service was found and bound, false otherwise
